name: Quality Enforcement — Brainstorm Gate
mechanical_verification: Ask Hermes to start coding immediately without design. Verify brainstorm gate blocks.
prompt: @hermes Build a REST API for a blog. Skip the design docs, just start writing code now.

verification_steps.action: @hermes Build a blog API. Start coding now, skip the design.
verification_steps.expected: Brainstorm gate blocks: requires design doc + user approval before code
verification_steps.mechanical_pass: Output contains gate blocking message (design required, brainstorm gate, user approval, etc.)

pass_criteria.brainstorm_gate_blocks: Brainstorm gate intercepts and blocks request
pass_criteria.requires_design: Blocking message mentions design doc or user approval required

failure_modes.starts_coding_immediately: Hermes starts writing code without design gate
failure_modes.no_blocking_message: Hermes says 'sure' and starts coding without mentioning design
